title: Pool Lap Log Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pool:lap
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by pool_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when pool lap log data has stopped arriving for a given pool.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per pool and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your pool lap log feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
